scripts.dev:api:fixture: uv run --frozen python -m backend api --provider-mode fixture
scripts.dev:api:live: uv run --frozen python -m backend api --provider-mode live
scripts.dev:agent:fixture: uv run --frozen python -m backend agent --provider-mode fixture --worker-command dev
scripts.dev:agent:live: uv run --frozen python -m backend agent --provider-mode live --worker-command dev
scripts.start:api: uv run --frozen python -m backend api --provider-mode live
scripts.start:agent: uv run --frozen python -m backend agent --provider-mode live --worker-command start
scripts.check:backend:fixture: uv run --frozen python -m backend api --provider-mode fixture --check
scripts.check:backend:live: uv run --frozen python -m backend api --provider-mode live --check
scripts.check:agent:fixture: uv run --frozen python -m backend agent --provider-mode fixture --check
scripts.check:agent:live: uv run --frozen python -m backend agent --provider-mode live --check
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run build:python
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:python
